title: How SKY crypto’s 12% price drop raises the risk of further losses
summary: SKY faces further downside risks as derivatives activity weakens despite healthy on-chain fundamentals.
content: The cryptocurrency SKY recently experienced a 12% price drop, raising concerns among investors about the potential for further losses. Although the network's on-chain fundamentals remain healthy, weakening derivatives activity suggests that downward pressure could persist in the near term, increasing overall risk for market participants.
content_ta: SKY என்ற cryptocurrency விலையில் 12% சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதால், மேலும் விலை குறையக்கூடும் என்ற அச்சம் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மத்தியில் எழுந்துள்ளது. on-chain அடிப்படையிலான அம்சங்கள் ஆரோக்கியமாக இருந்தாலும், derivatives சந்தையின் செயல்பாடு மந்தமாக இருப்பதால் சந்தையில் சரிவுக்கான வாய்ப்புகள் தொடரலாம் என்று கூறப்படுகிறது.

title: Anyflo emerges from stealth to simplify stablecoin payments for enterprises
summary: Stablecoin payments orchestration service Anyflo has emerged from stealth with news that it has acquired bitcoin lending platform Native.
content: Anyflo, a stablecoin payments orchestration service, has officially emerged from stealth. Alongside this launch, the company announced its acquisition of Native, a bitcoin lending platform. The strategic move aims to simplify and enhance stablecoin payment processes for enterprise clients navigating the digital asset landscape.
content_ta: Stablecoin payments orchestration service-аான Anyflo தனது stealth நிலையிலிருந்து அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக வெளிவந்துள்ளது. இந்த அறிமுகத்துடன், bitcoin lending platform-ஆன Native நிறுவனத்தை வாங்கியுள்ளதாகவும் இந்நிறுவனம் அறிவித்துள்ளது. டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தையில் இயங்கும் enterprise வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு stablecoin payment முறைகளை எளிமையாக்குவதை இந்த மூலோபாய நடவடிக்கை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Cantor Fitzgerald faces Senate Democrat’s questions over Tether ties
summary: The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.
content: Cantor Fitzgerald is facing questions from Senate Democrats regarding its ties to the stablecoin issuer Tether. This inquiry follows a recent report by Democratic investigators alleging that Tether's USDT cryptocurrency has been utilized as a significant tool for Iran's shadow banking network, prompting lawmakers to demand more transparency and information concerning financial connections.
content_ta: Tether நிறுவனத்துடனான அதன் தொடர்புகள் குறித்து Senate Democrats அமைப்பினர் Cantor Fitzgerald நிறுவனத்திடம் கேள்விகளை எழுப்பி வருகின்றனர். Tether-ன் USDT கிரிப்டோகரன்சி Iran-ன் நிழல் வங்கி வலைப்பின்னலுக்கு ஒரு முக்கிய கருவியாக மாறியுள்ளதாக Democratic புலனாய்வாளர்களின் அறிக்கை வெளியானதை அடுத்து இந்த விசாரணை வந்துள்ளது.

title: Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them
summary:
Abstract sets a Dec. 15 shutdown, but wallet access, supported routes and settlement determine whether holders can complete an exit.
The post Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Abstract has announced a shutdown scheduled for December 15. The closure highlights a critical gap between simply owning digital assets and having the necessary wallet access, routes, and settlement mechanisms required to successfully move and exit those holdings. Users are now facing challenges regarding how they can withdraw or transfer their funds before the platform officially ceases operations.
content_ta: Abstract நிறுவனம் டிசம்பர் 15 அன்று தனது சேவைகளை நிறுத்த உள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை வைத்திருப்பதற்கும், அவற்றை வெற்றிகரமாக வெளியேற்றுவதற்குத் தேவையான வாலட் அணுகல் மற்றும் செட்டில்மெண்ட் முறைகளைக் கொண்டிருப்பதற்கும் இடையே உள்ள பெரிய இடைவெளியை இந்த மூடல் வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது. பயனர்கள் தங்கள் நிதியை வெளியேற்றுவதில் சிக்கல்களை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளனர்.

title: XRPL’s $1.34 billion stablecoin base doesn’t tell us how much XRP users need
summary:
Fees and reserves require XRP, while larger demand depends on routing choices and the balances held in liquidity or credit products.
The post XRPL’s $1.34 billion stablecoin base doesn’t tell us how much XRP users need appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: The XRPL network features a substantial stablecoin base of $1.34 billion, yet this figure does not accurately indicate the total amount of XRP users actually need. While transaction fees and reserve requirements demand XRP, broader token demand largely depends on complex routing choices and individual balances held in various credit or liquidity products.
content_ta: XRPL நெட்வொர்க் $1.34 பில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் ஆதாரத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது, இருப்பினும் இந்த எண்ணிக்கை பயனர்களுக்கு உண்மையில் எவ்வளவு XRP தேவை என்பதைக் காட்டவில்லை. பரிவர்த்தனை கட்டணங்கள் மற்றும் இருப்புத் தேவைகளுக்கு XRP அவசியமானது, அதே நேரத்தில் பரந்த அளவிலான டோக்கன் தேவை பெரும்பாலும் ரூட்டிங் தேர்வுகள் மற்றும் கடன் அல்லது லிக்விடிட்டி தயாரிப்புகளில் வைத்திருக்கும் நிலுவைகளைப் பொறுத்தது.

title: Post-Quantum Custody Platform Strongpoint Adds Quantus As Development Partner
summary: Project Eleven and Quantus plan to integrate the Quantus Network with Strongpoint, Project Eleven's institutional custody platform for post-quantum blockchain assets. Quantus has joined as a development partner, with support targeted for the first quarter of 2027.
content: Project Eleven has added Quantus as a development partner for Strongpoint, its institutional custody platform designed for post-quantum blockchain assets. The partnership will focus on integrating the Quantus Network with Strongpoint. Full support for this integration is targeted for launch in the first quarter of 2027.
content_ta: போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பிளாக்செயின் சொத்துகளுக்கான இன்ஸ்டிடியூஷனல் கஸ்டடி பிளாட்பார்மான Strongpoint-இன் மேம்பாட்டு கூட்டாளியாக Quantus இணைந்துள்ளது. Project Eleven நிறுவனத்தின் இந்த திட்டமானது Quantus Network-ஐ Strongpoint-டன் ஒருங்கிணைப்பதில் கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது. இதற்கான முழு ஆதரவு 2027-ஆம் ஆண்டின் முதல் காலாண்டில் வெளியிட இலக்கு நிர்ணயிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Sui And Alibaba Cloud Want AI Agents Paying Their Own Cloud Bills In Stablecoins
summary: Sui and Alibaba Cloud are working on an integration that would let AI agents pay for cloud services per request using stablecoins within budgets set by their owners. The collaboration was unveiled at Sui Basecamp and remains under development, with no public launch date yet.
content: Sui and Alibaba Cloud are collaborating on a new integration that will allow autonomous AI agents to pay for cloud services using stablecoins. Revealed at the Sui Basecamp event, the upcoming system aims to let AI agents handle per-request billing within predefined budgets set by their human owners. The project is currently in development with no public launch date announced yet.
content_ta: Sui மற்றும் Alibaba Cloud நிறுவனங்கள் இணைந்து, AI agents-கள் stablecoins மூலம் தங்கள் கிளவுட் சேவைகளுக்கான கட்டணங்களை தாங்களே செலுத்தும் புதிய தொழில்நுட்பத்தை உருவாக்கி வருகின்றன. Sui Basecamp மாநாட்டில் அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட இந்த திட்டம், உரிமையாளர்கள் நிர்ணயித்த வரம்பிற்குள் இருந்து கொண்டு ஒவ்வொரு கோரிக்கைக்கான கட்டணத்தையும் AI agents செலுத்த வழிவகை செய்கிறது. இது தற்போது வளர்ச்சியில் உள்ளது, மேலும் இதன் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வெளியீட்டு தேதி இன்னும் அறிவிக்கப்படவில்லை.

title: NEAR crypto drops 16% a day after Bitwise’s bullish report
summary: Bitwise’s CIO says it’s one of the few small caps worth watching.
content: The NEAR cryptocurrency experienced a significant 16 percent drop in value, occurring just one day after Bitwise released a bullish report. Despite the downturn, the Chief Investment Officer at Bitwise highlighted NEAR as being among the few small-cap digital assets worth watching closely.
content_ta: NEAR கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் மதிப்பு 16 சதவீதம் சரிந்துள்ளது. Bitwise நிறுவனம் சாதகமான அறிக்கையை வெளியிட்டு ஒரு நாளுக்குப் பிறகு இந்த விலை சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், Bitwise நிறுவனத்தின் தலைமை முதலீட்டு அதிகாரி, கவனிக்க வேண்டிய சில முக்கிய ஸ்மால்-கேப் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துகளில் NEAR ஒன்றாகும் என்று குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: KBW's Michaud Explains What to Expect from a Pressured Q3 Bank Earnings Season
summary:
KBW CEO Tom Michaud says banks stay under pressure until rates settle ahead of Q3 bank earnings season. See what to expect.
The post KBW's Michaud Explains What to Expect from a Pressured Q3 Bank Earnings Season appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Ahead of the Q3 bank earnings season, KBW CEO Tom Michaud noted that banks will likely remain under pressure until interest rates stabilize. Investors and analysts are closely watching the financial sector to see how institutions are navigating the current economic environment and shifting monetary policies.
content_ta: Q3 bank earnings season-க்கு முன்னதாக, வட்டி விகிதங்கள் ஸ்திரமடையும் வரை வங்கிகள் தொடர்ந்து அழுத்தத்தில் இருக்கும் என்று KBW CEO Tom Michaud தெரிவித்துள்ளார். தற்போதைய பொருளாதாரச் சூழலையும் மாறிவரும் பணக்கொள்கைகளையும் நிதி நிறுவனங்கள் எவ்வாறு கையாள்வதை முதலீட்டாளர்களும் ஆய்வாளர்களும் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: You Could Be America's Enemy For Saying the Word”AI”
summary:
Trump's AI enemy warning meets Musk's SpaceXSI plan and a surge in Slovenian .si domains. See what is verified so far.
The post You Could Be America's Enemy For Saying the Word”AI” appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: A recent warning linked to Donald Trump suggests that using the word AI could potentially position someone as an enemy. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's SpaceX is advancing plans involving SI, alongside a notable surge in the registration of Slovenian .si domains. Observers are closely following these developments to verify further details as the story unfolds.
content_ta: Donald Trump-டன் தொடர்புடைய சமீபத்திய எச்சரிக்கை ஒன்று, AI என்ற சொல்லைப் பயன்படுத்துவது ஒருவரை எதிரியாக மாற்றக்கூடும் என்று குறிப்புகிறது. இதற்கிடையில், Elon Musk-ன் SpaceX நிறுவனம் SI தொடர்பான திட்டங்களை முன்னெடுத்து வருகிறது, மேலும் Slovenian .si டொமைன்களின் பதிவுகளில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க எழுச்சியும் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: 3 Stocks Already Winning the OpenAI vs. Anthropic Race
summary:
Vertiv, Quanta Services and GE Vernova report surging data center demand as OpenAI and Anthropic head for IPOs.
The post 3 Stocks Already Winning the OpenAI vs. Anthropic Race appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Vertiv, Quanta Services, and GE Vernova are emerging as early beneficiaries in the artificial intelligence race between OpenAI and Anthropic. These companies report surging demand for data center infrastructure as major AI firms continue to scale and prepare for potential initial public offerings.
content_ta: OpenAI மற்றும் Anthropic நிறுவனங்களுக்கு இடையேயான செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுப் போட்டியில் Vertiv, Quanta Services மற்றும் GE Vernova ஆகியவை ஆரம்ப கால பயனாளிகளாக உருவாகி வருகின்றன. முன்னணி AI நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தி பொதுப் பங்கு வெளியீட்டிற்கு (IPO) தயாராகி வருவதால், டேட்டா சென்டர் உள்கட்டமைப்புகளுக்கான தேவை அதிகரித்து வருவதாக இந்நிறுவனங்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.

title: Cloudflare CEO says AI micropayments need 10 million transactions per second
summary:
AI-driven micropayments could revolutionize digital transactions, challenging existing financial systems and reshaping web monetization models.
The post Cloudflare CEO says AI micropayments need 10 million transactions per second appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Cloudflare CEO notes that AI-driven micropayments have the potential to transform digital transactions and challenge traditional financial systems. Supporting this growing trend would require processing an immense volume of transactions per second, highlighting new demands for future web monetization models.
content_ta: AI-சார்ந்த micropayments டிஜிட்டல் பரிவர்த்தனைகளில் புரட்சியை ஏற்படுத்தி, பாரம்பரிய நிதி அமைப்புகளுக்கு சவாலாக அமையலாம் என்று Cloudflare CEO குறிப்பிடுகிறார். இந்த வளர்ந்து வரும் போக்கினை ஆதரிக்க வினாடிக்கு கோடிக்கணக்கான பரிவர்த்தனைகளைச் செயல்படுத்த வேண்டிய அவசியம் இருப்பதாக அவர் தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Democrats urge Maine voters to back Troy Jackson over Susan Collins in 2026 race
summary:
The Democrats' push for Jackson highlights a strategic effort to shift Maine's political landscape, potentially altering Senate dynamics.
The post Democrats urge Maine voters to back Troy Jackson over Susan Collins in 2026 race appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Democrats are urging Maine voters to support Troy Jackson over Susan Collins in the upcoming 2026 race. This political push highlights a strategic effort by the party to shift Maine's political landscape and potentially alter future Senate dynamics.
content_ta: 2026-ஆம் ஆண்டு நடைபெற உள்ள தேர்தலில் Susan Collins-க்கு எதிராக Troy Jackson-க்கு வாக்களிக்குமாறு Democrats தரப்பு Maine வாக்காளர்களை வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த அரசியல் நகர்வு, Maine மாநிலத்தின் அரசியல் களத்தை மாற்றி அமைப்பதற்கும் செனட் சபை நிலவரங்களை மாற்றுவதற்கும் கட்சியால் மேற்கொள்ளப்படும் ஒரு முக்கிய முயற்சியாக பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Investors reassess risks as AI financing rattles tech companies
summary:
Rising credit costs and default risks in AI financing could reshape tech investment strategies, highlighting vulnerabilities in corporate credit.
The post Investors reassess risks as AI financing rattles tech companies appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Investors are reassessing financial risks as heavy debt and credit costs related to artificial intelligence funding impact technology companies. Rising default risks are beginning to reshape broader tech investment strategies, drawing fresh attention to corporate credit vulnerabilities. These market shifts highlight growing concerns over how companies sustain large-scale technology investments amid tightening financial conditions.
content_ta: AI ஃபைனான்சிங் துறையில் அதிகரித்து வரும் கிரெடிட் செலவுகள் மற்றும் கடன் தவறும் அபாயங்கள் காரணமாக, இன்வெஸ்டர்கள் தங்களது முதலீட்டு உத்திகளை மறுபரிசீலனை செய்து வருகின்றனர். இந்தச் சூழல் கார்ப்பரேட் கிரெடிட் முறைகளில் உள்ள பலவீனங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுவதோடு, டெக் துறை முதலீடுகளில் புதிய மாற்றங்களை உருவாக்கும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: OpenAI pulls three AI-generated math papers one day after release
summary:
OpenAI's retraction highlights the challenges of AI in rigorous fields, emphasizing the need for transparency and robust verification processes.
The post OpenAI pulls three AI-generated math papers one day after release appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has retracted three artificial intelligence-generated mathematics papers just one day after their initial release. This quick withdrawal underscores the ongoing challenges and limitations associated with applying AI technologies to rigorous academic and technical fields. It also highlights the critical need for enhanced transparency and more robust verification processes when dealing with AI-produced research.
content_ta: OpenAI நிறுவனத்தால் வெளியிடப்பட்ட மூன்று AI-generated கணத ஆய்வுக் கட்டுரைகள், வெளியிடப்பட்ட ஒரே நாளுக்குப் பிறகு திரும்பப் பெறப்பட்டன. இந்த விரைவான நடவடிக்கை கடுமையான கல்வி மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்பத் துறைகளில் AI-ஐப் பயன்படுத்துவதில் உள்ள சவால்களை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது. மேலும் இது AI மூலம் உருவாக்கப்பட்ட ஆராய்ச்சிகளுக்கு மேம்பட்ட வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை மற்றும் நம்பகமான சரிபார்ப்பு செயல்முறைகள் தேவை என்பதை வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: Cardano Founder Accuses Ethereum Co-Founder Of ‘Bag-Holding’ Over AI Cryptography Warning
summary:
The post Cardano Founder Accuses Ethereum Co-Founder Of ‘Bag-Holding’ Over AI Cryptography Warning appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
Vitalik Buterin wants crypto to prepare for a threat that does not exist yet. Charles Hoskinson says that preparation could do more harm than the threat itself. On October 8, the Ethereum co-founder warned that AI-accelerated mathematics could break lattice-based cryptography, the backbone of the new post-quantum security standards. Within hours, the Cardano founder called …

Buterin recently claimed that AI-accelerated mathematics could undermine lattice-based cryptography, which forms the basis of new post-quantum security standards. Hoskinson argued that preparing for this unproven threat could cause more harm than the actual risk, sparking a fresh debate between the two prominent blockchain leaders.

AI-accelerated கணிதம் எதிர்கால பாதுகாப்பு தரநிலைகளை பாதிக்கலாம் என்று Buterin எச்சரித்திருந்தார். ஆனால், இந்த வராத அச்சுறுத்தலுக்காக தயாராவது உண்மையான ஆபத்தை விட அதிக சேதத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்று Hoskinson வாதிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush

content_ta: சமீபத்திய கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சந்தை சரிவில் சுமார் 1 பில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள வர்த்தக நிலைகள் முடக்கப்பட்டன. பிட்காயினை விட ஈதரின் இழப்புகள் கணிசமாக அதிகம் இருந்தன. 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் சுமார் $356 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான ETH நிலைகள் liquidate செய்யப்பட்டன. பிட்காயினின் சந்தை மதிப்பில் ஐந்தில் ஒரு பங்கிற்கும் குறைவாகவே ஈதர் இருந்தபோதிலும், இந்த அளவுக்கு அதிகமான வர்த்தக இழப்புகள் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது சந்தையின் தீவிர நிலையற்ற தன்மையைக் காட்டுகிறது.

content_ta: குறுக்கெல்லை பணப் பரிமாற்ற சேவைகள் இப்போது விலையை விட வெற்றிகரமான விகிதங்கள் மற்றும் வேகத்தின் அடிப்படையில் போட்டியிடுகின்றன. தொழில் துறை வல்லுநர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, நிலையான கட்டணப் பாதைகள் (static payment routing) மட்டுமே போதுமானதாக இல்லை. வளர்ந்து வரும் உலகளாவிய சந்தையில் வாடிக்கையாளர்களை ஈர்க்க நிறுவனங்கள் பரிமாற்ற வேகம் மற்றும் நம்பகத்தன்மையை மேம்படுத்துவதில் கவனம் செலுத்த வேண்டும்.

title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
summary: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.
content: A new Layer-1 blockchain technology called Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol designed to power bitcoin lending. The platform is set to debut with $500 million in commitments. It allows bitcoin holders to use their holdings as collateral for lending activities without needing to move the assets off the original Bitcoin network.
content_ta: Sui என்ற புதிய Layer-1 பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பம், பிட்காயின் லெண்டிங் பணிகளை மேம்படுத்தும் நோக்கில் Hashi என்ற நிறுவன நெறிமுறையைத் தொடங்குகிறது. இந்தத் தளம் 500 மில்லியன் டாலர் நிதி உறுதியளிப்புடன் அறிமுகமாகிறது. பிட்காயின் வைத்திருப்பவர்கள் தங்கள் சொத்துக்களை பிட்காயின் நெட்வொர்க்கிலிருந்து மாற்றாமல் ஈடாகப் பயன்படுத்த இது உதவுகிறது.

title: SIM-Swap Fraudster Who Spent Stolen Crypto on Gold Grills and Dubai Trips Jailed
summary: Ajay Shinjin helped steal nearly $265,000 in crypto after criminals hijacked BT customers' phone numbers in November 2021.
content: A man involved in a SIM-swap fraud scheme that stole nearly $265,000 worth of cryptocurrency has been sentenced to prison. The criminal hijacked BT customer phone numbers in November 2021 and used the stolen funds to finance luxury items, including gold grills and trips to Dubai.
content_ta: SIM-swap மோசடி மூலம் கிட்டத்தட்ட $265,000 மதிப்பிலான cryptocurrency-ஐ திருடிய வழக்கில் தொடர்புடைய ஒருவர் சிறையில் அடைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளார். நவம்பர் 2021-ல் BT வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் தொலைபேசி எண்களைக் கைப்பற்றிய குற்றவாளி, திருடப்பட்ட பணத்தைக் கொண்டு தங்கம் மற்றும் Dubai பயணங்கள் போன்ற ஆடம்பர செலவுகளைச் செய்துள்ளார்.

summary:

content_ta: CCIP 2.0 வெளியீட்டைத் தொடர்ந்து Chainlink கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் விலை 8 சதவீதம் சரிந்துள்ளது. உயர் காலக்கெடுவின் விலை போக்கு முன்னதாக சாதகமாக இருந்தபோதிலும், அக்டோபர் மாதத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட சந்தை அளவிலான திருத்தம் காரணமாக இந்த ஆல்ட்காயின் சரிவை எதிர்கொண்டது. இதனால் LINK டோக்கன் $12 என்ற ஆதரவு நிலையைத் தக்க வைத்துக் கொள்ள முடியுமா என்ற எதிர்பார்ப்பில் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் உள்ளனர்.

title: CaixaBank Expands Strategic Collaboration with Google Cloud to Accelerate AI and Data Capabilities
summary:
CaixaBank has announced an expanded strategic agreement with Google Cloud to strengthen its technological capabilities and accelerate the integration of AI, data management and cloud infrastructure across its business. Building on an alliance established in 2023, the agreement extends the collaboration until 2033 and aims to improve operational efficiency, support employee decision-making and enable more personalised products and services for the bank’s millions of customers.
 
As part of the agreement, CaixaBank will deploy Gemini Enterprise, Google Cloud’s platform for building, governing and deploying AI agents. These capabilities will enable teams to synthesise complex financial information, automate routine tasks and optimise daily workflows, supporting the bank’s ongoing digital transformation.
 
The expanded collaboration will focus on three strategic pillars: data analytics and agentic AI; hybrid infrastructure and security; and workforce training and enablement.
 
Accelerating decision-making through data and agentic AI
 
CaixaBank will use advanced data analytics and AI capabilities to turn large data repositories into actionable insights. Through Gemini Enterprise, teams will be able to deploy specialised AI agents to streamline document management and classification, summarise complex content and accelerate internal decision-making.
 
These capabilities are intended to help employees manage information more efficiently, reduce time spent on routine tasks and improve the use of data across the organisation.
 
Strengthening infrastructure, security and resilience
 
The agreement will combine CaixaBank’s private environment with Google Cloud’s secure infrastructure to improve system resilience, scalability and service availability as the bank’s technological needs evolve.
 
The collaboration will also introduce advanced threat detection and security monitoring capabilities. Their deployment will operate within CaixaBank’s established governance arrangements and security, privacy and responsible AI frameworks.
 
Building workforce capabilities and supporting adoption
 
The programme will include specialised professional services, collaborative initiatives and training courses to support the adoption of new technologies across CaixaBank. These activities will help equip teams with the skills and capabilities needed to integrate AI and data tools into their day-to-day work, while ensuring their use remains aligned with the bank’s governance and responsible AI principles.
 
Through the expanded agreement, CaixaBank continues to strengthen its collaboration with technology partners to advance the transformation of its business model. By combining Google Cloud’s AI and data capabilities with the bank’s technological expertise, the partnership aims to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences and support the continued development of digital banking.
 
CaixaBank, a leader in innovation
 
Innovation is one of CaixaBank’s strategic pillars and a key element in reinforcing its position in the financial sector. With more than 13 million digital customers, the bank has the largest digital customer base in Spain’s financial industry.
 
CaixaBank’s approach combines technology, expertise and customer proximity to develop new products and services, improve the customer experience, increase operational efficiency and create new opportunities for growth.

title: Nivo Launches Lender Collect: AI Case Coordination for the UK's Intermediated Lenders
summary:
Nivo has today launched Lender Collect, an AI assistant that coordinates a lending case from the first broker email through evidence gathering, underwriting preparation and the conditions that follow the lender's decision.
Lender Collect is available now to UK intermediated lenders, including bridging, specialist property, commercial and asset finance lenders. It extends the market-proven technology behind Nivo Collect, now live with over 15 brokers, to lenders, where more than 400 UK specialist and alternative lenders compete for brokers' business.
For intermediated lenders, the speed and ease of case handling help determine how much broker business they win. Yet much of the work remains manual, from keying enquiries into pricing spreadsheets and chasing statements and signatures to assembling the facts for an underwriting decision.
Getting started takes three steps: lenders provide their product guides, lending criteria, procedures, application forms and underwriter report template; Nivo configures the service around their case-handling requirements; then a case starts with a single email.
The AI reads the broker's instructions and attachments, identifies the parties, establishes amount, purpose, term, security and exit, and checks these against the lender's product criteria. It flags what fits, what needs clarifying and, where appropriate, an alternative product in the lender's range.
It requests evidence from the right people in the lender's preferred order, checks documents for completeness and consistency, populates forms, arranges signatures and sends consolidated reminders, escalating stalled cases. Company reports, identity checks and optional PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening are built in.
Before underwriting, it checks the evidence against the lender's rules and policies, raises further requests and drafts an editable report using the lender's template. This brings together the deal, criteria, evidence, calculations and discrepancies, with commentary and decision sections marked for the underwriter to confirm, amend or replace.
It then turns the underwriter's recorded conditions into document, form and signature tasks through to a signed loan agreement. Required evidence is tracked against the lender's instructions, with missing pages, conflicting details and unanswered conditions surfaced for review to reduce omissions.
Across lender contacts, brokers, applicants, guarantors, solicitors and valuers, Lender Collect tracks who owes what, completed tasks and how each connects to the next, a capability Nivo believes no other AI solution on the market offers today.
Exceptions, waivers, credit decisions and approvals stay with the lender's authorised team. Evidence gaps remain visible in the pack, including items waived or unobtainable.
Prompt, precise requests keep viable cases moving and reduce avoidable drop-off, supporting higher completion rates. Faster responses and easier case handling help lenders earn broker advocacy, repeat business and a greater share of brokers' business.
Cases progress 24/7, allowing brokers and customers to move them forward outside office hours, with a first response before a competitor has opened the email. Underwriters receive an organised pack and drafted commentary, giving the same team more capacity to focus on relationships, exceptions and lending.
Michael Common, CEO at Nivo, said:
"Every intermediated lender runs the same process: a query comes in, evidence is gathered, an underwriter decides, and the conditions are worked through to completion. The lenders that win are the ones that are fastest and easiest for brokers to deal with. Lender Collect answers in minutes rather than days, at any hour, using the lender's own criteria and documents. That is a conversion play as much as an efficiency play.
Nivo Collect showed brokers what an AI assistant can do with the gather, check and chase. Lender Collect brings that to the other side of the deal. Underwriters open a draft report built from checked evidence, with the decision firmly theirs. Nothing is approved, waived or decided by the AI."
Nivo's published security and compliance credentials include ISO 27001, ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 42001 certification, Cyber Essentials Plus, DIATF certification as an identity orchestrator and FSQS registration. Lender Collect includes encrypted data handling, a full audit trail and controls preventing client data being used to train underlying AI models.
Lender Collect also connects to existing origination and CRM systems via API and webhooks where required.

title: Supermicro Appoints Shesha Krishnapura to Board of Directors as an Independent Director and Announces the Retirement of Judy Lin

We look forward to benefiting from his experience and insights as we continue to drive innovation and create long-term value for our customers and shareholders.”
Mr. Krishnapura’s appointment reflects the Board’s ongoing focus on Board composition and refreshment. Judy Lin, who has served on the Board since 2022, will retire as of October 9, 2026.

title: Bitcoin speculators move 55K BTC to exchanges amid $1.1B liquidations
summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000, sparking mass crypto liquidations as traders sent BTC to exchanges at a loss.
content: Bitcoin speculators recently moved 55,000 BTC to exchanges as the cryptocurrency dipped below $81,000. This sudden price drop triggered massive crypto liquidations totaling $1.1 billion. Traders reacted to the volatile market conditions by sending their assets to trading platforms, often at a loss, as market uncertainty continued to impact digital asset holders.
content_ta: Bitcoin speculators தங்கள் வசமிருந்த 55,000 BTC-ஐ எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளுக்கு மாற்றியுள்ளனர். Bitcoin விலை $81,000-க்கும் கீழே குறைந்ததால், சந்தையில் $1.1 பில்லியன் அளவுக்கு பெரிய அளவில் லிக்விடேஷன்கள் (liquidations) ஏற்பட்டுள்ளன. சந்தையின் திடீர் வீழ்ச்சியால் வர்த்தகர்கள் தங்கள் சொத்துக்களை நஷ்டத்துடன் எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளுக்கு அனுப்பியுள்ளனர்.

title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced to 40 Years Over $430M Dark Web Bazaar
summary: Raheim Hamilton forfeited some 1,230 BTC. His co-creator Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is due to be sentenced this month.
content: Raheim Hamilton, a co-creator of the dark web marketplace Empire Market, has been sentenced to 40 years in prison following a massive $430 million drug and contraband operation. Hamilton was ordered to forfeit approximately 1,230 BTC. His co-creator, Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is scheduled to face sentencing later this month.
content_ta: டேர்க் வெப் சந்தையான Empire Market இன் இணை-நிறுவனர் Raheim Hamilton, $430 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள சட்டவிரோத நடவடிக்கைகளுக்காக 40 ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை பெற்றுள்ளார். அவர் சுமார் 1,230 BTC தொகையை இழக்க நேரிட்டது. அவரது இணை-நிறுவனர் Thomas Pavey, 1,584 BTC தொகையை இழக்க ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ள நிலையில், இந்த மாதம் தண்டனை பெற உள்ளார்.

title: AI agents can pay for your shopping. Who gets your money back?
summary:
Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore Payments, built with Coinbase and Stripe, lets AI agents discover paid services, authenticate, and pay with stablecoins and x402 under preset spending limits. AI agents are getting wallets before merchants get a court, and shopping agents have started placing orders across the open internet. The harder problem arrives once the payment clears, […]
The post AI agents can pay for your shopping. Who gets your money back? appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Amazon has introduced Bedrock AgentCore Payments, developed in partnership with Coinbase and Stripe. This new system allows AI agents to discover paid services, authenticate, and complete transactions using stablecoins and x402 within preset spending limits. While autonomous shopping agents are now actively placing orders across the internet, a major challenge remains regarding how consumers will secure refunds after a payment clears.
content_ta: Coinbase மற்றும் Stripe நிறுவனங்களின் கூட்டுடன் உருவாக்கிய Amazon நிறுவனத்தின் Bedrock AgentCore Payments அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய அமைப்பு AI agents மூலம் கட்டண சேவைகளைக் கண்டறிந்து, stablecoins மற்றும் x402 உதவியுடன் நிர்ணயிக்கப்பட்ட வரம்புகளுக்குள் பணம் செலுத்த அனுமதிக்கிறது. ஆன்லைனில் ஷாப்பிங் செய்யும் AI agents ஆர்டர்களைச் செய்யத் தொடங்கியுள்ள நிலையில், பணம் செலுத்திய பிறகு பணத்தைத் திரும்பப் பெறுவதில் உள்ள சிக்கல் சவாலாக உள்ளது.

title: Strategy’s $150 million-a-day STRC market has a hidden dependency on its own buybacks
summary:
Strategy's $1.45 billion preferred-share buyback program is supporting a substantial share of trading in one of its key Bitcoin financing instruments. According to a Keyrock research report, Strategy's repurchases accounted for more than 20% of weekly trading volume in its variable-rate preferred stock, STRC, during almost every week of September. The company's share reached about […]
The post Strategy’s $150 million-a-day STRC market has a hidden dependency on its own buybacks appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A recent research report reveals that Strategy's preferred-share buyback program supports a significant portion of trading in its Bitcoin financing instrument, STRC. According to the findings, company repurchases accounted for over 20 percent of weekly trading volume in STRC during nearly every week in September, highlighting a heavy reliance on its own buybacks to sustain the market.
content_ta: Strategy நிறுவனத்தின் விருப்பப் பங்குத் திரும்பப் பெறும் திட்டம் (buyback program), அதன் முக்கிய Bitcoin நிதியுதவிக் கருவியான STRC-ன் வர்த்தகத்தில் பெரும்பகுதியை ஆதரிக்கிறது என்பதை ஒரு புதிய ஆய்வு அறிக்கை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது. ஆய்வின்படி, செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தில் கிட்டத்தட்ட ஒவ்வொரு வாரமும் STRC-ன் வாராந்திர வர்த்தக அளவில் 20 சதவீதத்திற்கும் அதிகமான பங்குகளை இந்நிறுவனத்தின் திரும்பப் வாங்குதல்களே ஈடுசெய்துள்ளன.

title: MEXC and Payward Highlight Collaboration as Crypto and TradFi Converge at TOKEN2049
summary: October 9, 2026 – MEXC,a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, and Payward, the parent company of Kraken, shared their perspectives on the convergence of crypto and traditional finance during a TOKEN2049 Singapore panel. MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi, discussed how broader market access, retail demand and collaboration between platforms could shape the future of global trading. Crypto and TradFi Move Closer Together An important theme was the shift toward more connected, always-on markets. Vugar said blockchain infrastructure is challenging traditional market structures built around fixed trading hours, while users increasingly expect access to different asset classes through a more seamless experience. “Over the next five years, we’ll see a convergence toward a singular platform where asset classes and investments can move quickly and smoothly,” said Vugar. “Retail will be the main driver.” Arjun highlighted the infrastructure challenge behind this shift, noting that 24/7 trading is ultimately about bringing assets and collateral into a more connected financial environment. “24/7 trading really means: how do you bring all that collateral into one place?” said Arjun. Collaboration Over Competition Both speakers also highlighted collaboration as an important part of scaling the next generation of global trading platforms. Arjun noted that serving a much larger global user base will require platforms to work with partners that bring different strengths in their respective markets, explicitly pointing to MEXC as one such example. “The only way to do that is to partner with folks, including MEXC, to be able to help succeed in their core markets,” said Arjun. Vugar similarly emphasized that exchanges can increasingly build on one another’s strengths rather than approach every opportunity purely through competition. MEXC brings a retail-first approach, deep liquidity and broad experience in perpetual markets across crypto and TradFi assets, while Payward brings global financial infrastructure, professional trading capabilities and strong market experience in the United States. The discussion built on the two companies’ earlier indication that they are exploring broader collaboration, with both executives pointing to infrastructure, market access and distribution as areas where greater connectivity between platforms could create value. Trust and access were also highlighted as essential foundations for this evolution. Vugar described trust and access as two of the most important elements in building future financial platforms, while Arjun emphasized the importance of transparency as the industry becomes more connected. The panel pointed to a future in which crypto and TradFi become increasingly connected, with collaboration between platforms helping bring together market access, infrastructure and user reach to serve a broader global audience.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   Source   Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions.
content: At the TOKEN2049 event, executives from MEXC and Payward discussed the growing convergence between cryptocurrency and traditional finance. Leaders from both platforms highlighted how 24/7 trading, blockchain infrastructure, and increased collaboration could shape the future of global markets. They emphasized that partnerships between major trading platforms will be essential to improve market access, scalability, and user trust as retail demand continues to drive the industry forward.
content_ta: TOKEN2049 நிகழ்வில், cryptocurrency மற்றும் traditional finance ஆகியவற்றுக்கு இடையேயான வளர்ச்சி குறித்து MEXC மற்றும் Payward நிறுவனங்களின் உயர் அதிகாரிகளிடையே விவாதிக்கப்பட்டது. 24 மணி நேர வர்த்தகம் மற்றும் ஒத்துழைப்பு ஆகியவை உலகளாவிய சந்தைகளின் எதிர்காலத்தை எவ்வாறு வடிவமைக்கும் என்பதை அவர்கள் சுட்டிக்காட்டினர்.

title: Charles Hoskinson Disputes Vitalik Buterin’s Warning Against Lattice Cryptography
summary: Hoskinson argues that decades of lattice cryptanalysis already inform ML-KEM and ML-DSA security parameters, challenging Vitalik's fears.
content: Charles Hoskinson has challenged Vitalik Buterin's recent warning regarding lattice cryptography. Hoskinson argued that decades of cryptanalysis work already provide a strong foundation for the security parameters used in ML-KEM and ML-DSA. This response pushes back against concerns over the readiness and safety of these cryptographic systems.
content_ta: Lattice cryptography குறித்த Vitalik Buterin-ன் சமீபத்திய எச்சரிக்கையை Charles Hoskinson மறுத்துள்ளார். பல தசாப்த கால cryptanalysis ஆய்வுகள் ML-KEM மற்றும் ML-DSA பாதுகாப்பு அளவுருக்களுக்கு ஏற்கனவே வலுவான அடிப்படையை வழங்கியுள்ளன என்று Hoskinson வாதிட்டுள்ளார். இந்த கிரிப்டோகிராபிக் அமைப்புகளின் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்த அச்சங்களுக்கு இந்த பதில் முற்றுப்புள்ளி வைக்கிறது.

title: 6 Reasons Bitcoin Crashed by $7K in 3 Days: Bull Market Over or Regular Correction?
summary: From major ETF outflows to another Fed rate-hike warning. Here's what pushed BTC south, and whether it was an anticipated event or there's more pain on the horizon.
content: Bitcoin experienced a significant price drop, falling by $7,000 over three days. Analysts are examining the causes behind the steep decline, which include notable ETF outflows and warnings regarding Federal Reserve interest rates. Investors are currently debating whether this sudden downturn marks the end of the current bull market or simply serves as a standard market correction.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை மூன்று நாட்களில் 7,000 டாலர்கள் வரை சரிந்து பெரும் அதிர்ச்சியை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வீழ்ச்சிக்கான காரணங்களாக முக்கிய ETF வெளியேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் Federal Reserve வட்டி விகித எச்சரிக்கைகள் ஆகியவை ஆராயப்பட்டு வருகின்றன. இந்த திடீர் சரிவு தற்போதைய bull market-ன் முடிவா அல்லது சாதாரண correction-ஆ என்பது குறித்து முதலீட்டாளர்கள் விவாதித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Bitcoin price tests $80K – Why $402M BTC ETF outflows threaten ‘Uptober’
summary: The Bitcoin regime score needs to push above zero, and the price needs to recover back above $83.2k and $84k resistance to signal a recovery.
content: Bitcoin price recently tested the $80,000 level amid significant ETF outflows totaling $402 million, raising concerns over the market's 'Uptober' momentum. Analysts note that the Bitcoin regime score must rise above zero, while the price needs to break past resistance levels at $83.2k and $84k to signal a true recovery and renew bullish sentiment.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை சமீபத்தில் $80,000 மதிப்பைச் சோதித்தது. மேலும் $402 மில்லியன் அளவிலான ETF வெளியேற்றங்கள் 'Uptober' சந்தைப் போக்கிற்கு அச்சுறுத்தலாக அமைந்துள்ளன. Bitcoin ஆட்சியின் மதிப்பெண் பூஜ்ஜியத்திற்கு மேல் உயர வேண்டும் என்றும், விலை மீட்சியை உறுதிப்படுத்த $83.2k மற்றும் $84k எதிர்ப்பு நிலைகளைக் தாண்டி மீண்டு வர வேண்டும் என்றும் ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: ‘Not fast enough’ – Starknet eyes Ethereum exit amid quantum fears
summary: Will Starknet's STRK token benefit more from the post-AI and quantum security narrative?
content: Starknet is reportedly considering a potential exit from Ethereum due to concerns over quantum security risks and the network's processing speed. As quantum technology advances, the blockchain faces growing security challenges, raising questions about whether Starknet and its STRK token can adapt and benefit from emerging post-quantum narratives.
content_ta: குவாண்டம் பாதுகாப்பு அச்சுறுத்தல்கள் மற்றும் நெட்வொர்க்கின் வேகம் தொடர்பான கவலைகள் காரணமாக Starknet நிறுவனம் Ethereum-ஐ விட்டு வெளியேறுவது குறித்து பரிசீலித்து வருவதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. குவாண்டம் தொழில்நுட்பம் வளர்ச்சியடைந்து வருவதால், பிளாக்செயின் நெட்வொர்க்குகள் எதிர்கால பாதுகாப்பு சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றன. இதனால் Starknet மற்றும் அதன் STRK டோக்கன் இந்த புதிய சூழ்நிலையில் எத்தகைய பலன்களைப் பெறும் என்ற கேள்விகள் எழுந்துள்ளன.

title: Analyzing how HBAR crypto retreated from 2026’s highs thanks to market-wide bearishness
summary: A steep short-term correction alongside a wider-market sell-off made news.
content: The HBAR cryptocurrency recently retreated from its 2026 highs, driven by a steep short-term correction and a wider-market sell-off. As market-wide bearish sentiment took hold, the digital asset experienced notable downward pressure alongside the broader financial landscape.
content_ta: சந்தை முழுவதிலும் நிலவிய கரடி சந்தை (bearish) போக்கு காரணமாக, HBAR கிரிப்டோகரன்சி தனது 2026 ஆம் ஆண்டின் உச்சத்திலிருந்து சமீபத்தில் பின்வாங்கியுள்ளது. திடீர் குறுகிய கால திருத்தம் மற்றும் பரந்த சந்தை விற்பனை அழுத்தம் காரணமாக இந்த விலை சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Cardano Midnight Posts 9,100% Transaction Surge After Smart Contract Deployment
summary: Permissionless smart contracts went live on the  Midnight mainnet in major milestone for the network.
content: The Cardano Midnight network experienced a remarkable 9,100% surge in transaction activity following the successful deployment of permissionless smart contracts. This major milestone marks a significant step forward for the network, bringing new capabilities to its mainnet and driving a massive increase in on-chain engagement as developers and users begin utilizing the newly enabled smart contract functionality.
content_ta: Cardano Midnight நெட்வொர்க்கில் permissionless smart contracts வெற்றிகரமாக அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டதைத் தொடர்ந்து, பரிவர்த்தனை நடவடிக்கைகளில் 9,100% வரை மிகப்பெரிய உயர்வு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த முக்கிய மைல்கல் நெட்வொர்க்கின் mainnet-க்கு ஒரு குறிப்பிடத்தக்க முன்னேற்றத்தைக் குறிப்பதோடு, புதிய ஸ்மார்ட் கான்ட்ராக்ட் வசதிகளை டெவலப்பர்களும் பயனர்களும் பயன்படுத்தத் தொடங்குவதால் ஆன்-செய்ன் ஈடுபாட்டில் மிகப்பெரிய வளர்ச்சியை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin Returns to ETF Holders’ Breakeven Price, and $729 Million Heads for the Exit
summary:
Bitcoin ETF investors pulled $729M as BTC hit their cost basis. See why Fidelity, not BlackRock, is driving the outflows.
The post Bitcoin Returns to ETF Holders’ Breakeven Price, and $729 Million Heads for the Exit appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Bitcoin recently returned to the breakeven price level for exchange-traded fund holders. Following this price movement, approximately $729 million in outflows headed for the exit as ETF investors pulled their funds. Reports indicate that Fidelity has been a key driver behind these recent outflows rather than BlackRock, as investors reacted to Bitcoin reaching their initial cost basis.
content_ta: Bitcoin சமீப, ETF வைத்திருப்பவர்களின் பிரேக்-ஈவன் விலைக்கு திரும்பியது. இந்த விலை மாற்றத்தைத் தொடர்ந்து, ETF முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தங்கள் நிதியை திரும்பப் பெற்றதால், சுமார் $729 மில்லியன் வெளிசென்றது. BlackRock-ஐ விட Fidelity-தான் இந்த வெளிவெளியீடுகளுக்கு முக்கிய காரணமாக உள்ளது என்று அறிக்கைகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன, ஏனெனில் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் Bitcoin அவர்களின் ஆரம்ப அடக்க விலையை அடைந்ததை எதிர்கொண்டனர்.

title: Ray Dalio Warns the Stocks Are Losing Their Cushion, and the Worst May Be Ahead
summary:
Billionaire investor Ray Dalio says the buffer protecting stocks from rising bond yields is shrinking fast. His warning comes as the 10-year Treasury yield hovers near multi-decade highs. tags: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
content: American Express National Bank has been hit with a $350 million civil money penalty by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. The US banking regulator took action due to identified deficiencies within the bank's anti-money laundering and bank secrecy act processes.
content_ta: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency அமைப்பால் American Express National Bank நிறுவனத்திற்கு $350 மில்லியன் அபராதம் விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. வங்கியின் anti-money laundering மற்றும் bank secrecy act செயல்முறைகளில் கண்டறியப்பட்ட குறைபாடுகள் காரணமாக இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: FintechOS Elevate '26 to Unveil Blue Sky Release as AI Leaders Gather in London
summary:
FintechOS, the agentic platform for unified product operations in financial services, will host its annual Elevate 2026 conference on 14th October at King's Place, London, bringing together executives and AI leaders in financial services for a full day exploring how AI is reshaping product operations in banking and insurance. The invitation-only event will feature the launch of FintechOS 8 Blue Sky, the company's latest platform release. 
Now in its second year, Elevate runs dedicated tracks for banking and insurance, with sessions exploring AI's impact on product operations, customer experience, operational efficiency and governance. The conference will showcase how institutions are moving from AI pilots to production-grade deployment, with live platform demos, keynotes, panels and fireside chats throughout the day. 
Confirmed speakers include Leda Glyptis, author and board advisor; Dharmesh Mistry, author of The Intelligent Ledger and a 40-year veteran of banking technology; Paroma Chatterjee, CEO of Revolut India; and Rania Svoronou, Global Head of AI Design at Citi, along with executives & AI leaders from leading institutions including ElevenLabs, HSBC Innovation, Howden, Societe Generale, the FCA and many others. 
The Blue Sky release marks a shift in how AI operates within banking and insurance, unifying product rules, pricing workflows and semantic data models in a single operational record. 
"AI offers far more than speed to market and cost reduction; it opens genuinely new ways of delivery product innovation and customer satisfaction", said Teo Blidarus, CEO and Founder of FintechOS. "With FintechOS 8 Blue Sky, product and pricing rules, workflows and the semantic data model sit in one record, so AI works inside live banking and insurance operations, not in pilots at the edge. This is a new chapter for FintechOS and for the industry: organisations that build with intelligence and run with intelligence. On 14 October we gather at Elevate '26 to mark the moment and look ahead to what comes next." 
Elevate comes as FintechOS enters a period of accelerated growth. The company recently secured $28 million in combined equity and debt financing to scale its AI-native platform and expand in the US. 
The conference agenda addresses themes central to the industry's current trajectory, with product innovation tracks exploring how agentic AI and unified product operations reduce the time from concept to live product. The day concludes with a networking reception and gala dinner. 
Senior leaders from banks, insurers and the wider financial services ecosystem can apply to join Elevate 2026. Places are limited. Applications will be reviewed by the FintechOS team, with attendance confirmed within two working days. Media interested in attending can also request accreditation through the Elevate website.

title: BDO Unibank Powers Smarter, Next-Generation Payments with Finastra
summary:
Finastra, a global leader in financial services software, today announced that BDO Unibank, Inc. (BDO) has enhanced its payments infrastructure with Finastra’s modern Global PAYplus (GPP), reinforcing the bank’s ability to support growing transaction volumes, strengthen operational resilience, and advance interoperability across the payments ecosystem.
As a leading universal bank in the Philippines, BDO serves retail, commercial, and institutional clients across a broad range of banking and financial services. The bank also supports correspondent banking and fintech partners with payment distribution capabilities into the Philippine market.
The deployment of GPP’s high-value and mass-payments capabilities provides a scalable foundation for current and future payment requirements. BDO currently utilizes the platform for Swift and inbound PESONet processing and is the largest commercial bank in the Philippines leveraging GPP.
With GPP, the bank benefits from greater automation, flexible rule-based payment processing, and improved operational efficiency, while gaining the agility to support evolving industry standards such as ISO 20022 and connect to new domestic and cross-border payment networks as they emerge.
“Payments are a critical enabler of commerce and economic activity, making resilient and scalable infrastructure increasingly important,”  said Carlo B. Nazareno, head of Cash Management Services at BDO. “By enhancing our payments architecture with Finastra’s Global PAYplus, we have strengthened our ability to support growing transaction volumes, improve operational efficiency, and adapt to evolving market requirements. This provides a strong foundation for delivering a seamless client experience today while supporting future innovation across the payments ecosystem.”
“Banks around the world are under growing pressure to deliver payment experiences that are immediate, reliable, and tailored to increasingly diverse customer needs,” said Radha Suvarna, Chief Product Officer of Payments at Finastra. “By bringing high-value and mass-payments processing together on Global PAYplus, BDO is reducing complexity while creating a more flexible foundation for innovation. We are proud to support the bank as it advances its payments capabilities and expands the services it can provide to customers. Our partnership demonstrates both the international capabilities of our solution, as well as our commitment to supporting banks with complex requirements, including multiple clearing systems and nuanced corporate client needs.”
This approach reflects a broader shift in the industry toward unified, AI-enabled payment hubs that consolidate and orchestrate multiple rails. It also reflects the importance of cloud-native, API-enabled architecture, ISO 20022 support, and intelligent operations as important foundations for payments innovation, operational efficiency, and faster time to market.

title: FCA's Andrew Self, Dr Ruth Wandhöfer and Former Big Brother Producer Maz Farrelly Headline Open Banking Expo UK & Europe Next Week
summary:
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe returns to London's Business Design Centre on 13 and 14 October, bringing together more than 1,800 attendees and 200 industry speakers for two days of insight, debate and collaboration at a pivotal moment for Open Banking, Open Finance and Smart Data.
With less than a week to go, final preparations are underway for one of the industry's biggest gatherings of the year, as financial institutions, fintechs, regulators, policymakers and technology providers prepare to explore the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of financial services.
Taking place across four stages of content each day, alongside the Engine Room podcast studio, the event will examine how the industry can move beyond ambition and regulation towards delivering real commercial and consumer value.
With the Smart Data agenda gathering momentum, the continued evolution of Open Banking payments and growing interest in Open Finance, the conversations taking place in London next week come at a critical time for the sector.
Industry-leading keynotes set the agenda
The Main Stage will welcome a diverse line-up of keynote speakers, combining regulatory insight, industry expertise and fresh perspectives from beyond financial services.
On Tuesday 13 October, Andrew Self, Head of Department, Open Banking & Open Finance at the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), will deliver an opening keynote exploring 'Moving from Open Banking into Open Finance: What's needed to unlock the next chapter?'.
His address comes as the industry looks towards the next phase of regulatory and commercial development, with questions around collaboration, innovation and the future framework for Open Finance firmly in focus.
Dr Ruth Wandhöfer, internationally recognised financial services and technology expert, will take to the stage on Wednesday 14 October to explore 'The post-payments world: Open Banking, AI and the new architecture of value'. Her keynote will examine how emerging technologies are reshaping financial services and creating new opportunities for innovation.
Bringing the conference to a memorable close will be Maz Farrelly, the award-winning television executive behind some of the world's biggest entertainment shows, including Big Brother and The X Factor.
In her closing Main Stage keynote, 'Why be boring when you can be bad ass', Farrelly will draw on more than 30 years in television to challenge conventional business thinking and reveal what financial services can learn from showbusiness about capturing attention, communicating with impact and creating unforgettable experiences.
From Open Banking to Open Finance: Turning ambition into action
Across the two days, the conference programme will tackle some of the most pressing issues facing the financial services ecosystem.
The Main Stage will bring together influential voices to examine the direction of Open Banking and Open Finance, while the dedicated Payments Stage will explore the continued growth of Pay by Bank, variable recurring payments and the opportunities presented by account-to-account transactions.
The co-located Open Finance Show will examine the commercial opportunities emerging from greater access to financial data, including new business models, customer propositions and the infrastructure needed to support them.
On Day One, the Smart Data Stage will explore how the principles of Open Banking can extend into other sectors, while Day Two will introduce the Trust & Identity Stage, focusing on the technologies and frameworks underpinning secure digital interactions.
The programme will also feature the new Question Time format, encouraging lively debate and audience participation on the issues shaping the industry's future.
More than a conference: Where the industry connects
Alongside the content programme, attendees will have access to an exhibition featuring more than 40 organisations showcasing the technologies and solutions driving the next generation of financial services.
The Expo floor will provide opportunities to discover new products, meet potential partners and explore practical applications of Open Banking and Open Finance.
The Engine Room returns with recorded conversations bringing together industry leaders for more in-depth discussions, while dedicated networking spaces and facilitated networking sessions will help attendees build valuable new relationships.
With decision-makers, innovators and regulators all under one roof, the event offers an opportunity to move conversations forward, establish partnerships and turn ideas into action.
Celebrating the industry's achievements
The Open Banking Expo Awards 2026 will take place on the evening of Tuesday 13 October, recognising the individuals, teams and organisations making an outstanding contribution to the advancement of Open Banking and Open Finance.
Following a record year for entries, the ceremony will celebrate excellence across the ecosystem, from technological innovation and customer impact to industry leadership and collaboration.
The countdown is on
As Open Banking and Open Finance enter their next chapter, the need for meaningful industry collaboration has never been greater.
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe 2026 will bring together the people, ideas and organisations shaping that future, providing two days of discussion, practical insight and opportunities to build the relationships that will drive the industry forward.
Open Banking Expo UK & Europe takes place on Tuesday 13 and Wednesday 14 October 2026 at the Business Design Centre, London.
With just days remaining, there is still time to join the conversation.
https://www.openbankingexpo.com/uk/

title: 4 Banks and Credit Unions Recognized for AI Innovation
summary:
Glia, Banking AI platform, today announced the winners of its 2026 Catalyst Awards, which honor the most forward-thinking institutions using Banking AI to create measurable impact across growth, operational efficiency and customer experience.
This year’s winners demonstrate the expanding role of Banking AI — retaining millions in deposits, creating thousands of hours of workforce capacity, resolving customer needs around the clock, and equipping employees with real-time knowledge to fuel personalization and cross-selling. Together, these banks and credit unions are proof that with Banking AI, community and regional institutions can compete with megabanks and fintechs without sacrificing the relationships and experience that have always differentiated them.
“As AI moves from automating routine tasks to completing complex operating procedures, these institutions are leading the way,” said Dan Michaeli, co-founder and CEO of Glia. “By methodically building and scaling Banking AI into their operations, they’ve positioned themselves ahead of the industry — directly benefiting their employees, local communities and account holders. We are proud to partner with them and celebrate their incredible momentum.”
Glia’s 2026 Catalyst Awards winners include:
Heartland Credit Union, recipient of the Harmonizer Award for using Banking AI to create faster, more efficient member service across voice interactions. Glia saves Heartland more than 6,000 staff hours annually — giving them the additional capacity of nearly four full-time employees — while reducing average wait time for a human operator by 40% and call abandonment by 54%.
	“We view Banking AI as a way to empower our members with faster, 24/7 self-service options while allowing our employees to focus on higher-value conversations that require empathy, expertise and personalized financial guidance,” said Daniel Mijal, vice president of digital strategy at Heartland Credit Union. “Glia helped us achieve the scale of a megabank without losing the personal feel our members know and trust.”

Live Oak Bank, recipient of the Pacesetter Award for demonstrating how AI-enabled customer engagement can translate into deeper banking relationships. With Glia’s Banking AI, the technology-forward bank maintained a 93% first-contact resolution rate while more than doubling the volume of interactions handled entirely by AI. Live Oak's checking balances grew 63% year-over-year, and 25% of its customers now hold both a loan and a deposit account, up from 18% a year prior. Voice AI gives the bank the capacity to serve those relationships around the clock.

We are grateful for our partnership with Glia, whose expertise and collaboration have helped us accelerate our digital engagement strategy and enhance the way we serve members. We are honored to be recognized by Glia and remain focused on building even better experiences in the years ahead.”

Together, this year’s Catalyst Award winners demonstrate the transformative power of AI built specifically for community banks and credit unions. title: Ledgebrook Raises USD 200 Million in Primary Equity Financing Co-Led by Allianz X to Scale AI-Native Specialty Insurance Platform
summary:
Ledgebrook, the AI-native specialty insurance platform, today announced it has raised USD 200 million in primary equity financing co-led by Allianz X, the strategic investment arm of the Allianz Group, and Rockefeller Capital Management. Existing and new investors also participated. Ledgebrook will use the funds to scale its technology and extend Blackbird, Ledgebrook's proprietary AI-native underwriting platform. Separately, Allianz Re has agreed to enter a multi-year reinsurance agreement with Ledgebrook.
Headquartered in Boston, Ledgebrook sits between the brokers who need cover for hard-to-place risks and the capital that backs them, running on technology it built from the ground up. It writes general liability, professional liability, and specialty cover for mid-sized-market businesses in the E&S market, distributed exclusively through wholesale brokers. Ledgebrook's proprietary AI-based platform, Blackbird, reads submissions, classifies risk, and calculates a technical price, quoting specialty risks, often in hours rather than weeks, with experienced underwriters making the final decision. As such, brokers, and therefore their clients, get fast, reliable answers on placing risks. Ledgebrook's approach has put it on track to surpass USD 1 billion in cumulative premium written since it started writing business in 2023.
Gage Caligaris, Founder & CEO of Ledgebrook, said: "Our vision is for Ledgebrook to be the company that makes the wheels of insurance spin faster. Businesses with complex risk deserve specialized underwriting, rated with rigor and delivered at speed. Our platform lets our underwriters do that with real discipline. Allianz X backing gives us the capital to keep investing in technology and talent. We're building this company for the long term."
Dr. Nazim Cetin, CEO of Allianz X, said: "The industry is applying AI to its simplest risks first, because that is where automation comes easily. We think the larger prize sits at the other end, in complex, hard to place business, where underwriting judgment is scarce and slow decisions cost the most. That's exactly the gap Blackbird is built to close, and it's why Ledgebrook fills a meaningful space in our U.S. P&C platform."
John Mullen, President of E&S at Ledgebrook, added: "E&S is seeing strong multi-year growth. Admitted carriers tightened their appetite and pushed risks that were once routinely placed in the admitted market into this channel, and we're excited about accelerating the delivery of value to our distribution partners and insured customers in this segment."
This investment both scales and diversifies Allianz X's U.S. P&C platform, which is built across various lines of business and segments from micro to mid-sized. Ledgebrook writes general liability in the mid-sized segment of the E&S market, filling a meaningful gap on the platform, deepening Allianz's presence in that space, and complementing Allianz X's existing positions.

title: CMORG Holds Sector-Wide Cloud Outage Simulation Exercise
summary:
The Cross-Market Operational Resilience Group (CMORG) yesterday (8 October 2026) completed its biennial simulation exercise, known as SIMEX26, focused this year on a global cloud services disruption.
The group – chaired by the Bank of England (the Bank) and UK Finance, with participation from HM Treasury, the Financial Conduct Authority and the wider financial sector – met to undertake a wide-ranging crisis management exercise, with the 38 largest and most systemically important banks and market infrastructure operators involved.
The exercise, which was opened by the Economic Secretary to the Treasury and hosted by the London Stock Exchange Group, involved firms working alongside the financial authorities to respond to a scenario focusing on global disruption to cloud-based services. 
It also included a live meeting of the Bank-chaired Cross Market Business Continuity Group, which provides strategic direction to the sector’s collective response to systemic incidents. The Bank now expects firms to take action based on the exercise to further strengthen their resilience and ability to respond to severe operational and cyber scenarios.
Katharine Braddick, Deputy Governor of Prudential Regulation at the Bank of England and CEO of the Prudential Regulation Authority said: 
 "This was an important demonstration of the UK financial sector's commitment to operational resilience. The level of collaboration reflects the priority firms place on maintaining critical services in the face of disruption. That preparedness is essential to safeguarding financial stability."
David Postings, Chief Executive of UK Finance, said:
“Maintaining resilience across the financial sector is critical to supporting confidence, stability, and growth in the UK economy. SIMEX 2026 enabled us to collectively strengthen preparedness and ensure the sector is better equipped to respond to significant disruptive events while continuing to deliver essential services to customers.”
Economic Secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby said:
 “The operational resilience of our world-leading financial services sector is core to maintaining financial stability.



The SIMEX programme supports the financial sector’s operational resilience by rehearsing the response to the most challenging scenarios. Previous exercises, including those in 2022 and 2024, considered cyber-attacks against a major bank, as well as critical infrastructure disruption outside the financial sector.
SIMEX 26 builds on work done by the Bank of England, working in collaboration with the financial authorities and industry through CMORG, to boost operational resilience in financial services. In recent months, this has included strengthening third party engagement and resilience, enabling secure innovation in response to AI and other emerging technologies, and enhancing cyber preparedness, response and recovery for the most severe disruption scenarios.

title: Alkami and Bank Director Discuss How Banking Leaders Can Take AI from Ambition to Governed Action
summary:
Alkami Technology, Inc., a digital sales and service platform provider for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced an upcoming webinar, "From AI Ambition to Action: Strategies That Deliver Measurable Results," in partnership with Bank Director. The session will take place Tuesday, October 13, at 1 p.m. CDT.
As financial institutions assess the implications of artificial intelligence (AI), questions about practical applications and responsible adoption remain central to the conversation. The upcoming webinar will bring together industry thought leaders and product experts to discuss how banks and credit unions are approaching their AI strategy. The webinar will explore how financial institutions can connect AI initiatives to defined outcomes while keeping data quality, human judgment, compliance and risk policies, and account holder trust at the center.
Drawing on Alkami's proprietary research into consumer perceptions surrounding AI, the discussion will examine how consumers believe AI will impact their banking experience and where financial institutions can create value people can feel. Speakers will consider why protection and service may be natural starting points for earning account holders' permission to do more with AI, and how regional and community financial institutions can use their relationship advantage as AI changes the way account holders interact with money.
"AI creates an opportunity for digital banking to move from recommendation to progress," said Stephen Bohanon, founder and chief strategy officer at Alkami. "Recognizing what an account holder needs is only part of the equation. The real value comes from helping them move from intent to action with less friction, more confidence, and the right institutional controls in place."
The conversation will cover:
Why AI strategy should begin with a business problem and a measurable outcome, rather than with the technology itself.
How trusted data, clear ownership, and a shared view of institutional knowledge create the foundation for useful AI.
Why governance, training, accountability, and human review need to be designed into adoption from the beginning.
How financial institutions can progress from assistance and recommendations toward bounded, auditable action within approved policies and permissions.
"AI earns trust when it improves a person's financial life in a way they can feel," said Theo Lau, founder of Unconventional Ventures. "For financial institutions, that means starting with a real need and choosing an approach that fits the institution's mission. title: SoFi Tech Solutions, Orbi and Mastercard Partner to Launch Crypto-Linked Card in Mexico
summary:
SoFi Tech Solutions, formerly Galileo, today announced a partnership with Mexican fintech Orbi and Mastercard to launch a crypto-linked card program in Mexico. The program will let Orbi customers use either traditional fiat currency or funds from their crypto balances through a seamless conversion at the time of purchase, while merchants receive traditional fiat currency.
Stablecoins accounted for 40% of crypto purchases among Bitso users in Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and Colombia in 2025, compared with 18% for bitcoin. This marked the first time stablecoins overtook bitcoin in Bitso’s regional purchase data.
SoFi Tech Solutions will provide the BIN sponsorship and financial technology infrastructure behind the Orbi card program, including issuing, transaction authorization, processing and compliance capabilities. Partnering with SoFi and its SoFiUSD stablecoin, provided a unique solution that brought all the components together. The platform will also support future stablecoin-powered use cases.
“Mexico is one of the world’s largest remittance markets, and stablecoins are becoming an increasingly important way to move money across its borders,” said Kathleen Pierce-Gilmore, President of SoFi Tech Solutions. “Together with Orbi and Mastercard, we are giving people in Mexico a trusted way to receive, hold and spend digital dollars, while laying the foundation for stablecoin-powered payments and cross-border money movement at scale.”
The partnership will let Orbi customers make purchases with physical and virtual cards linked to their crypto balances, with funds converted at the point of sale so merchants receive fiat currency. SoFi Tech Solutions’ connection to Mastercard’s domestic payment network in Mexico, Mexico Domestic Switch (MxDS), will support card purchases and cash withdrawals at ATMs.
“The Orbi Mastercard is the result of our collaboration with SoFi Tech Solutions and Mastercard, a partnership that has continued to deepen since our earliest days,” said Leonardo Perez, Co-founder of Orbi. “We are building an experience that turns digital dollars into real-world purchasing power, giving people in Mexico a familiar way to use their assets wherever Mastercard is accepted.”
“Digital assets are becoming an increasingly important part of how people hold and move money, and the opportunity is to make them as easy and trusted to use as traditional forms of payment,” adds Silvana Hernández, North Division President for Mastercard LATAM. “By working with SoFi Tech Solutions and Orbi, we’re enabling stablecoin settlement while helping connect digital assets to the payment experiences people already know, with the security and widespread acceptance of the Mastercard network.”
SoFi Tech Solutions’ connection to Mastercard’s domestic payment network in Mexico, Mexico Domestic Switch (MxDS), will support card purchases and cash withdrawals at ATMs.
Bringing SoFi’s U.S. financial technology experience to Latin America
SoFi Tech Solutions, formerly Galileo Financial Technologies, brings to Latin America the experience SoFi has gained building, operating and scaling digital financial services in the United States. Combined with Galileo’s more than 30 years of payments and processing expertise and Technisys’ modern core banking capabilities, this experience helps financial services providers across the region build connected, digital-first products designed for the evolving needs of their customers.
The platform provides access to:
Issuer processing and cards: Debit, credit and prepaid processing, including real-time controls, digital issuance, tokenization, push provisioning, cardholder services and rewards.
Payments and money movement: Access to ACH, wires, real-time payments, card-based money movement and emerging digital asset settlement.
Core banking: Modern core and ledger capabilities to configure and launch financial products while managing accounts and transactions in real time.
Digital banking: Composable capabilities for building and enhancing mobile and web financial experiences.
Lending: Technology supporting the credit lifecycle and the development and management of differentiated lending products.
Fraud and risk management: Integrated controls and real-time decisioning across accounts, cards and payments.
Clients can use these capabilities independently or combine them according to their needs, creating a path to modernize at their own pace and scale as their businesses – and customers – evolve.
Today, nearly 200 clients rely on SoFi Tech Solutions to power financial products and services. Its technology supports approximately 135 million accounts and has processed billions of transactions and supported money movement at trillion-dollar scale over the past three years.

content: SoFi Tech Solutions, Orbi, and Mastercard have partnered to launch a crypto-linked card program in Mexico. SoFi Tech Solutions will provide the underlying financial technology infrastructure, while Mastercard's network ensures widespread merchant acceptance and ATM access across the region.

content_ta: Amazon நிறுவனர் Jeff Bezos, செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவின் (AI) வேகமான வளர்ச்சி எதிர்கால வேலைவாய்ப்பு சந்தையை முழுமையாக மாற்றியமைக்கலாம் என்று கணித்துள்ளார். AI-ஆல் அதிகரிக்கும் உற்பத்தித் திறன் காரணமாக எதிர்காலத்தில் மூன்று நாள் வேலைவாரம் மற்றும் ஒற்றை வருமானக் குடும்பங்கள் சாத்தியமாகலாம் என்று அவர் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இருப்பினும், இந்த பொருளாதார பலன்கள் அனைவருக்கும் சமமாக சென்று சேர்வதை உறுதி செய்வது முக்கிய சவாலாக இருக்கும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

content_ta: NCUA-வின் போர்டு காலியாக இருந்த ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட காலம் குறித்து விளக்கம் கேட்டு Senator Elizabeth Warren கடிதம் எழுதியுள்ளார். இரண்டு வாரங்களுக்கு மேலாக போர்டு உறுப்பினர்கள் யாரும் பதவியில் இல்லாததால், அந்த காலகட்டத்தில் நிர்வாகத்தை கவனித்தது யார் என்ற கேள்வியை அவர் எழுப்பியுள்ளார்.
